newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan king leaves U.S. hospital.
newsitem.headline: Jordan king leaves U.S. hospital.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein left a U.S. hospital on Sunday and doctors who checked him for a recurrence of cancer said he was clear of the disease, the state news agency Petra reported.
But doctors advised the king, 61, to undergo a "minor operation to remove part of an inflamed prostate gland as soon as possible", Petra said. It said the operation was common for men of his age.
King Hussein has returned annually to the Mayo Clinic in Minnesota since a successful surgery for cancer in 1992, with no recurrence of the disease.
The monarch is due to hold talks with President Bill Clinton and senior officials later this month or in early April on bilateral ties, Iraq and the latest tension in the Middle East.
